title: Kompass: Constitutional bodies: Bundestag, Bundesrat, President, Chancellor
tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: Constitutional bodies: Bundestag, Bundesrat, President, Chancellor (1/2)
exercises.body: Memorize this one diagram in words. **Das Volk** elects the **Bundestag** (4-year term). The Bundestag elects the **Bundeskanzler(in)**, head of *government*, runs policy (Richtlinienkompetenz), picks ministers. The **Bundespräsident(in)**, head of *state*, 5-year term, is elected by the **Bundesversammlung** (all Bundestag MPs + equal number of Land delegates), and mostly *represents*: signs laws, formally appoints, proposes the Chancellor candidate.

exercises.title: Kompass: Constitutional bodies: Bundestag, Bundesrat, President, Chancellor (2/2)
exercises.body: The **Bundesrat** is not elected at all: it consists of Land-government representatives, giving the 16 Länder their voice in federal law. The **Bundesverfassungsgericht** (Karlsruhe) guards the constitution over them all. Chancellor ≠ President is the single most-tested distinction in the catalog. Party alphabet soup: CDU/CSU (Christian democrats; CSU only in Bavaria), SPD (social democrats, oldest party), FDP (liberals), Grüne, AfD, Linke.

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: Verfassungsorgane: Bundestag, Bundesrat, Bundespräsident, Bundeskanzler
exercises.body: Die fünf Verfassungsorgane: Bundestag (macht Gesetze, wählt den Kanzler), Bundesrat (die Länder), Bundespräsident (repräsentiert, ernennt), Bundesregierung (Kanzler + Minister) und Bundesverfassungsgericht (hütet das Grundgesetz). ⏰ Aktuelle Namen (Kanzler, Präsident, Fraktionen) vor der Prüfung checken!
